notes: Loom is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 LOOM once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. Transfers have no fees or burns. There are no administrative or additional minting entrypoints, application contracts, or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
